description_full: Sigma Lithium Corporation engages in the exploration and development of lithium deposits in Brazil. It serves lithium-ion battery supply chain for electric vehicle industries. The company was formerly known as Sigma Lithium Resources Corporation and changed its name to Sigma Lithium Corporation in July 2021. Sigma Lithium Corporation is based in Toronto, Canada.
